sloka: आशामाशम् समानानाम् दीनानामूर्ध्वचक्षुषाम् ।आर्थिनाम् वितथाम् कुर्याद्यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५०॥
transliteration: āśāmāśam samānānām dīnānāmūrdhvacakṣuṣām ।ārthinām vitathām kuryādyasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-50॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person disappoints who miserable mendicants seeking alms and looking up to him for help
